title: Edit the heading of an existing hero
request: Change the hero headline to "Ship the page, not the ticket" and make the subtext shorter.
rubric: Does it edit the hero that is already there rather than adding a second one?
why: The most common real request and the one a plan generator most often gets wrong: it inserts a NEW hero instead of setting props on the existing node. `requiredTargetNodeIds` makes that failure mechanical.
